title: Inference after data-driven control-unit selection in difference-in-differences with estimated covariance
abstract: arXiv:2610.01464v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In difference-in-differences (DiD), researchers may use pre-treatment trends to select a control group for which the parallel-trends assumption appears plausible, with the aim of estimating the average treatment effect on the treated (ATT). Our earlier paper,Nakano and Hoshino (2016), and the present paper jointly provide the first selective-inference approach to the ATT that explicitly accounts for this control selection. We generalize our exact Gaussian procedure with known covariance to allow the covariance matrix to be estimated from the same individual-level data used for control selection and DiD estimation. We use this estimate to compute the variance, conditioning direction, residual, and truncation set. With fixed numbers of regions and periods, we establish uniform conditional coverage for selection events with probabilities bounded away from zero, and marginal coverage of the selected target without that restriction. translated_title: 在具有估计协方差的双重差分法中，数据驱动控制单位选择后的统计推断
translated_abstract: 在双重差分法中，研究者可能利用处理前趋势来选择一个使平行趋势假设看起来合理的控制组，目的是估计处理组的平均处理效应（ATT）。我们此前的论文（Nakano and Hoshino, 2016）与本文共同提供了首个明确考虑这种控制组选择的ATT选择性推断方法。我们将具有已知协方差矩阵的精确高斯方法加以推广，允许协方差矩阵从用于控制组选择和DiD估计的相同个体层面数据中进行估计，并利用该估计来计算方差、条件方向、残差和截断集。在区域数和期数固定的条件下，我们对选择事件概率有非零下界的情形建立了选择事件的一致条件覆盖率保证，并在没有该限制的情况下对所选择的目标建立了边际覆盖率保证。我们允许……（摘要未完整提供）
tldr: 本文首次提出了针对双重差分法中数据驱动控制组选择后ATT估计的选择性推断方法，并将其推广到协方差矩阵需从同一数据估计的情形，同时建立了条件覆盖与边际覆盖的保证。
en_tdlr: This paper provides the first selective inference approach for ATT in difference-in-differences with data-driven control selection, extending an exact Gaussian procedure to the case of an estimated covariance matrix while establishing uniform conditional and marginal coverage guarantees.
